[[Deldrimor Blades]] are [[unique item|unique]] [[daggers]] traded by [[Artisan of Shadows]], a [[collector]] in [[Droknar's Forge (explorable area)]].

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 7-17 (Requires 9 [[Dagger Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Life Draining]]: 3
:[[Health regeneration]]: -1
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the non-unique [[Deldrimor Daggers]].
